technical.summary: Strong moving average confluence and volume spike support bullish structure, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of reversal.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 75 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (3+ years old) and news data unavailable, limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.84) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 75 days presents moderate event risk; macro score of -3 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross confluence (EMA 9/21 and SMA 9/21) combined with 15x volume spike and bullish OBV create strong technical structure for mean-reversion entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 71.62, Stoch 82.57), weak ADX trend conviction (13.6), zero fundamental support, high earnings risk within 75 days, and crisis-level VIX (371.84) in unfavourable macro environment outweigh technical signals.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — moderate entry quality between support 19.4832 and resistance 20.9538; no clear directional conviction from price structure alone

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows golden cross confluence and volume spike, but overbought oscillators (RSI 71.62, Stoch 82.57) and weak ADX trend conviction (13.6) signal exhaustion rather than sustainable entry. Fear-zone contrarian opportunity exists, but fundamental vacuum and high earnings risk within 75 days do not justify swing trade initiation.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (371.84) in unfavourable macro environment combined with moderate earnings event risk in 75 days creates asymmetric downside; overbought technicals vulnerable to sharp pullback before any upside extension.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers weak contrarian offset
